text: Assumption: For simple UART controllers without hardware LIN support, software-based byte buffering leads to a noticeably higher interrupt load — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: For simple UART controllers without hardware LIN support, software-based byte buffering leads to a noticeably higher interrupt load — is this correct?
norm: for simple uart controllers without hardware lin support software based byte buffering leads to a noticeably higher interrupt load
assumption: For simple UART controllers without hardware LIN support, software-based byte buffering leads to a noticeably higher interrupt load.
rationale: SWS_Lin_00026 requires software buffering in the absence of hardware queues, which causes frequent ISR invocations.

original.text: Annahme: Bei einfachen UART-Controllern ohne Hardware-LIN-Unterstützung dürfte die softwarebasierte Byte-Pufferung zu einer spürbar höheren Interrupt-Belastung führen — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Bei einfachen UART-Controllern ohne Hardware-LIN-Unterstützung dürfte die softwarebasierte Byte-Pufferung zu einer spürbar höheren Interrupt-Belastung führen.
original.rationale: SWS_Lin_00026 fordert Softwarepufferung bei fehlenden Hardware-Queues, was häufige ISR-Aufrufe bedingt.
